# wallix-bastion_apikey (Resource)

Provides an API key resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Basic API key, usable from any IP
resource "wallix-bastion_apikey" "ci_pipeline" {
  apikey_name = "ci_pipeline"
}

# API key restricted to specific source IPs
resource "wallix-bastion_apikey" "monitoring" {
  apikey_name   = "monitoring"
  ip_limitation = "10.10.11.22,10.10.33.44"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `apikey_name` (String)

### Optional

- `ip_limitation` (String)

### Read-Only

- `apikey` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Usage Notes

### The `apikey` attribute

The Bastion API never returns the raw API key value, at creation or afterward — the `apikey`
attribute always reads back as a masked placeholder (`********`). Terraform can manage the key's
name and IP restriction, but retrieving the usable secret value requires the Bastion web UI (or
another out-of-band process) at creation time.

### IP Limitation

`ip_limitation` is a comma-separated list of IP addresses allowed to use the key. Leave it unset
(or empty) to allow use from any IP.

## Import

API key can be imported using its `apikey_name`, e.g.

```shell
terraform import wallix-bastion_apikey.ci_pipeline testacc_APIKey
```
